claims_reviewed.claim: A Network IT-branded PNet advert for Quality Assurance Tester (Cape Town: Northern Suburbs, ID 4267528; ref ITE008025-FDg-1) was retrievable.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page https://www.pnet.co.za/jobs--Quality-Assurance-Tester-Cape-Town-Northern-Suburbs-Network-IT--4267528-inline.html displays the title, location, Network IT advertiser and the listed role; PNet Western Cape profile https://www.pnet.co.za/cmp/en/network-it-51190/jobs/in-western-cape includes it in the 33-result snapshot.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold as a PNet agency advert only, not as proof of the hiring employer.

claims_reviewed.claim: Network IT is a Network Recruitment division.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Official Network Recruitment IT service page https://www.networkrecruitmentinternational.com/it identifies Network IT and links to its IT vacancy route.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the agency-division attribution only; official dynamic vacancy cards were not available in page retrieval.

claims_reviewed.claim: The detail page describes a QA Tester / Software Test Analyst role covering manual and automated web/mobile testing, defects, regression and Agile delivery.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page; the role is not inferred from the recruiter profile.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold only the role text present on the direct page.

claims_reviewed.claim: The direct PNet detail page states R500,000–R600,000 annually.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct page shows “R 500 000 - R 600 000 - Annually.” The advert describes a health-technology organisation but does not name it.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the stated annual range for the economic screen; preserve employer identity and compensation-basis unknowns.

claims_reviewed.claim: The R420,000 p.a. economic salary gate is cleared by the stated annual range.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The directly displayed annual lower bound is R500,000, above R420,000 p.a.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the economic salary screen on the stated annual package or explicit monthly amount ×12; do not infer package basis or total rewards.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct PNet page identifies Network IT as advertiser but uses an anonymous client description and does not name the hiring employer.
claims_reviewed.decision: Reject any employer inference from sector, role wording, location or recruiter identity.

claims_reviewed.claim: The employer-side vacancy is confirmed to remain open.
claims_reviewed.evidence: A PNet detail page and relative publication age were visible at retrieval; no employer confirmation or closing date is shown.
claims_reviewed.decision: Downgrade to “listed on PNet at retrieval”; employer-side acceptance remains unknown.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The end employer is not identified; no Boschendal or Laurium match is evidenced.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not promote to agreed-client priority.

claims_reviewed.claim: Whether the stated annual package is base or CTC is not specified.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet source comparison recorded in the role review artifact; no employer confirmation is available.
claims_reviewed.decision: Retain the relationship only as an unresolved research hypothesis.

claims_upheld: A direct PNet Network IT listing for Quality Assurance Tester (4267528) existed at retrieval.
Network IT is an official Network Recruitment IT division.
Role requirements and pay evidence were transcribed from the direct PNet detail page; annualization of monthly pay is explicitly ×12.
claims_downgraded: A live PNet detail page does not confirm that the end employer is still accepting applications.
Network IT is the agency advertiser, not the identified end employer.
No employer name, agreed-client status, stakeholder or company-email pattern is established.
contradictions: The official Network IT vacancy feed did not expose job cards through page retrieval; this PNet profile is a third-party fallback, not complete native-source coverage.
unknowns: End-employer name and employer-side requisition status are unresolved.
Client/agreed-client status is unresolved; no Boschendal or Laurium match is evidenced.
No end-employer stakeholder/contact or company-email intelligence can be grounded until the employer is identified.
Whether the stated annual package is base or CTC is not specified.
next_research_actions: Seek an agency-origin or employer-origin source that identifies the hiring employer and confirms the requisition is still open; do not infer from generic sector wording.
Confirm compensation basis/CTC components where material to the economic gate.
Do not begin end-employer stakeholder/company-email research, target-company mapping or candidate mapping until employer identity is confirmed or high-confidence.
